senses.gloss: , perf. a. part. גָּף (= גָּפַף) [to join body to body,] to squeeze, cork, bung.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 6b">Nidd. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה גָּפָה וכ׳</he> was corking (pitching) wine jugs.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11b:7">M. Kat. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>כדו לָגוֹף</he> we take for the mourner his wine jug for corking. [<cite ref="Moed Katan 11b:7">Ib.</cite> Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:1">ib. II, 1</cite> <he>וגף</he>, omitted in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note.] <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 3:12">Maas. Sh. III, 12</cite> <he>אע״פ שגָּפָן</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 2:18">Tosef. ib. II, 18</cite> <he>שגָּפָם</he> (Var. <he>גּוֹפָם</he> fr. <cite ref="C01200"><he>גָּפָה</he></cite>) though he corked them; a. e.

senses.gloss: to embrace, hug. Y. Yoma III, 41ᵃ גִּיְּיפוֹ he put his arms around it.
(Neh. VII, 3) to fill up (a hole), close (a door), fasten.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 6:1">Par. VI, 1</cite>. Ohol. XIII, 3 <he>הֵגִיפָהּ ולא וכ׳</he> he filled the hole out but not entirely.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 3:2">Zab. III, 2</cite> <he>מֵגִיפִין או פותחין</he> if both close or open a door simultaneously.

Tosef. Ohol. XIV, 1; a. e.—Part. pass. מוּגָף fastened. Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ מ׳ צריכה if the door (behind the suspected couple) was closed (but not locked), it is doubtful (whether the woman is to be considered a Sotah, v. סוֹטָה).
